holds_without_pictures_note: Measured on scratch copies of corp1 and local1 with every photograph removed (probe/d-corp-nophotos.html, probe/e-local-nophotos.html): no sideways scroll, no spill, one h1, legible ok at 1440 and 390 (see measured_on), picture share 0. The opening becomes a full-screen block of the strong colour with the h1; steps and groups stand as words in the right half; people are type-only tiles; quotes turn on the strong colour. It holds as a plain typographic page, but the reference is photograph-led and this template should be offered for its photographs: at least the opening, the band and two halves.
